description: Ministry of Internal Affairs Wayamba Development and Cultural Affairs - Notifying that the Registration of Persons Regulations Published in Gaz.Exord. No. 1946/31 of 22.12.2015 been approved by the Parliament and that come into effect from 10.02.2016
reasoning: This gazette notification announces the parliamentary approval and effective date of regulations made under the Registration of Persons Act, No. 32 of 1968. The content focuses on the legal/regulatory framework for person registration, which falls under Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5) as it deals with statutory instruments and regulatory compliance requirements rather than government personnel changes or organizational matters.
